note: Benzie County has no countywide zoning ordinance; townships, villages and cities each zone their own land. Their zoning maps (Frankfort, Benzonia village and township, Lake Township) are published only as PDF maps. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or download of zoning districts found in the county, state or city searches. The county parcel layer (services5.arcgis.com/lcdRo4JSOTVu3FMR/.../Benzie_County_Parcels/FeatureServer/1) has no zoning field.
